name: Women Working
overview: Scripture presents women as purposeful and active contributors within God's design, beginning with Eve as a suitable helper for Adam (Genesis 2:18). Women are depicted as industrious and skilled, exemplified by those who spun fine materials for the tabernacle (Exodus 35:25) and by the wise woman who builds her household (Proverbs 14:1). Leadership roles are also acknowledged, as seen in Deborah's role as prophetess and judge (Judges 4:4). The Proverbs 31 passage highlights the value and virtue of a woman whose worth surpasses precious gems, emphasizing her strength, wisdom, and diligent work.
